scope: Blender5.2.3 LTS: previous mesh/material/live/render contracts and typed scene production, reviewed shader/geometry/compositor nodes, object/bone motion, weighted deformation, bounded rigid-body/cloth evaluation, product turntable intent and five evaluated exchange formats. This does not claim full Blender workflow coverage. Direct scene-production route and self-contained native/neutral asset reuse preserve editable project hierarchy/materials/child animation; linked/stateful external dependencies remain explicitly unsupported. Typed mesh fields, named UV/projection/unwrap/packing and explicit prototype sharing are implemented; complete strategic coverage remains unfinished. Typed Object/Collection Info, prototype/whole-asset selectors and conservative dependency/expansion admission extend this scope; imported unbounded node/cache geometry remains unfinished. Finite local element selection and ordered topology edits compose enclosure construction, field authoring and native/neutral asset reuse; unrestricted native mesh-operator coverage remains unfinished. Curve/builtin-font source sampling includes preview/render maxima and supported keyed envelopes before procedural attachment. Editable classic multi-spline controls, rational weights, dimensional filling, explicit quarter profiles, Object sections/taper dependencies and fixed path consumers are included; generic valid-solid output and all native curve operators are not claimed. Source Curve and builtin-Font section/taper references participate in dependency and expansion admission; legacy Curve mesh components are exported once while distinct collection instances remain distinct. Partial trimming requires constant point radius per spline because the fixed native release can retain an untrimmed endpoint radius; this refused combination remains an open variant, not a valid-solid claim. Typed Cycles/EEVEE/Workbench engine intent, display transforms and distinct material/object/mesh-attribute colours extend rendering; broader rendering, probe/cache, OCIO and pass/output families remain incomplete. Captured single-file Workbench image previews select independent material images, alpha interpretation and active UVs; painting, baking and UDIM remain incomplete. Named DATA surface layouts and exact-data OBJECT palettes add bounded per-face, per-spline and character assignment; broader material workflows remain incomplete. Typed layered artist surfaces compile the reviewed built-in Principled/image/normal/displacement vocabulary; optional built-in OSL exposes meaningful Smart filtering without Script/code authoring. UVsphere constructor topology is deterministic before publication; exact fresh input authority remains mandatory. Finite public render bundles add named view layers, CPU scientific EXR planes and Cryptomatte, managed PNG/EXR output, logical Material/World AOV taps and captured collection masks. Cycles Freestyle adds bounded technical lines. Explicit rigid-packed and cloth-packed/disk requests add freshly reconstructed all-frame cache verification. Whole Blender remains incomplete.
acceptance: Run examples/schemaxis/blender-primitives.json and independently check the produced scene and geometry.
Run examples/schemaxis/blender-render-groups.json and verify rendered images.
Run tests/unit/test_blender_live.py with the target executable configured through its documented test environment variable; require zero native skips.
Run tools/qualify_blender_production.py with the target executable; require all connected cases, fresh native verification and independent motion/deformation/physics expectations.
Run tools/qualify_blender_nodes.py inside the target Blender process; require every reviewed constructor/default/socket/property and saved/reopened graph check.
Run tools/qualify_blender_outputs.py and require independent host parsing plus fresh native reimports for all5frame export formats and physical unit variants.

Run tools/qualify_blender_assets.py: packed native project and all declared neutral asset formats must reuse through product turntable, three rendered frames, all five exports and fresh current-byte native project checks.

Run tools/qualify_blender_asset_tamper.py against the native reuse-blend fixture; reject refreshed-hash material roughness, unsampled animation key, UV and skin-weight edits using fresh trusted current-code verification.

Run tools/qualify_blender_mesh_data.py: require independent field deformation, all chosen type/domain/storage variants, UV area/pixel-gap checks, explicit sharing/selection, shader pixels and native edit/adopt; optional captured CAD baseline and variant must preserve independently expected dimensions.

Run tools/qualify_blender_mesh_data_tamper.py against that accepted suite: refreshed native hashes must not hide typed field, UV/seam, reader or sharing mutations; unchanged native saves must pass the identical current-native path.

Run tools/qualify_blender_mesh_field_nodes.py: Boolean sparse masks must change only selected evaluated vertices, and normalized quaternion fields must rotate realized asymmetric instances to independently expected bounds.

Run tools/qualify_blender_geometry_resources.py and tools/qualify_blender_geometry_resource_assets.py: require literal frame/transform/prototype/whole-asset effects, selected-part fields/modifiers, independent captured CAD accessor/index counts and dimensions, and dependency/expansion refusals.

Run tools/qualify_blender_geometry_resource_tamper.py: resolved pointer, group-interface, collection-offset and part-modifier mutations must refuse after refreshed hashes; unchanged saves must pass the identical trusted native path.

Run tools/qualify_blender_geometry_resource_animation.py: a small animated array must keep literal bounds/counts, while later-key and Bezier-overshoot expansion refuse before modifier attachment; unbounded driver/NLA topology must refuse explicitly.

Run tools/qualify_blender_geometry_resource_lifecycle.py: six rotated/scaled Object/Collection frame cases require literal bounds; packed native project adoption must preserve edited pointers, reopen without its original source, refuse receipt verification while the original is absent, then verify after restoration.

Run tools/qualify_blender_mesh_edits.py: require independently calculated enclosure volume, concave polygon area, welded/deleted counts, loop closure, both halfspace cuts and native/DAG source replay, including material rebinds, explicit data-loss refusal and captured CAD composition. Require refreshed-hash topology/source-witness tamper refusals and identical unchanged-save positives separately.

Run tools/qualify_blender_mesh_edit_lifecycle.py: require authored enclosure dimensions/volume, post-edit morph samples, independently parsed physical GLB, a manual native edit adopted as a new source and original/retained source verification lifecycle.

Run tools/qualify_blender_curve_resource_budget.py: actual viewport/render geometry must stay under the conservative bound; small curved Curve/Font positives must pass while static and later-key high render resolution refuse before attachment. Unsampled render-resolution native mutations must refuse with identical unchanged-save controls.

Run tools/qualify_blender_splines.py, tools/qualify_blender_spline_tamper.py and tools/qualify_blender_spline_lifecycle.py with the fixed runtime: require independent cubic/rational samples, valid gasket extrusion volume, distinct fill-rule areas, profile section area times length, taper radii/volume, fixed path positions, refreshed-hash control/pointer mutations and unchanged-save positives, native edit/adopt, physical GLB and original-source lifecycle. Native UI preset property assignment alone must never count as a working preset mapping.

Run tools/qualify_blender_font_profiles.py: small builtin-font Object-profile geometry must retain independently known section Z extent, while a high-control profile refuses conservative expansion before procedural attachment.

Run tools/qualify_blender_spline_admission.py: instrument native construction to require oversized source refusal before mesh-data operators and re-admission before material evaluation, with an unchanged small control that reaches the same material boundary. No large curve is evaluated by this control.

Spline precision must preserve adjacent control edge vectors, cyclic closing edges and explicit handle offsets independently of overall span. Require representable mixed-scale controls, native float-collapse refusals and a refreshed-hash short-edge mutation with unchanged-save control.

Require independent planar offset area6.25, weighted rational orders4/5/6 with per-spline sampling and distinct original-versus-trimmed taper endpoint radii. Partial trim with varying point radii must refuse while full varying-radius and partial constant-radius controls pass.
Run tools/qualify_blender_render_policy.py for independent encoded colour/exposure expectations, attribute/instance and saved-scene compositions.

Run tools/qualify_blender_render_settings.py and tools/qualify_blender_render_controls.py for current native readback, refreshed-hash changes and unchanged-save positives; preserve scoped verification limits.

Run tools/qualify_blender_asset_source.py: source selector edits and replaced submitted fidelity must fail against fresh captured-source construction; authorised field/edit overlays and unchanged native saves must pass. Include changed large integer IDs, integer-to-float conversion and small custom-double metadata edits with replacement witnesses; native float rounding must not relax these exact metadata values/types.

Run tools/qualify_blender_image_preview.py with the fixed runtime: require independent encoded pixels for distinct images/UVs, swatch fallback, linear-data interpretation, zero/one and fractional alpha, independent shader output and a materially different scientific two-panel composition.

Run tools/qualify_blender_image_preview_lifecycle.py: require refreshed-hash helper/image/UV refusals and unchanged-save control, original-source removal/restoration, actual captured-input native edit/adoption and verified resume reuse, source-authority refusal despite replaced submitted fidelity, and structured resource/cancel/deadline recovery.

Run tools/qualify_blender_material_assignments.py, tools/qualify_blender_material_tamper.py and tools/qualify_blender_material_lifecycle.py: require independent two/four-region Cycles and Workbench/image pixels, copy/shared and exact data identity, topology/field/UV and spline/text composition, actual adopted native palette edits and explicit captured-part remap, refreshed-hash slot/index/link/pointer attacks with unchanged saves, coforged source witness refusal and lifecycle recovery. Require bounded selector scan work before geometry access and a sparse-region positive. Run actual Studio material layout and Object palette browser forms; broader shader/paint/UDIM/baking and Grease Pencil remain incomplete.

Run tools/qualify_blender_shader_fidelity.py: reconstruct all admitted authored shader state and owner-qualified embedded asset trees before submitted open; refuse hidden sockets, Cycles settings, Line Art changes and nested/second-tree mutations with refreshed hashes and replaced readbacks. Require unchanged saves, editor-placement/default-read positives and restored current fidelity/2 proof. Recognised fidelity/1 receipts require fresh trusted-original-input runs; missing/unknown versions and relabelled colliding keys must not select a legacy reader.

Run tools/qualify_blender_shader_budget.py and tests/unit/test_blender_shader_budget.py: check distinct allocation, repeated-instance expansion, aggregate materials and unused group depth before native launch; small shared nested materials must render independently expected colours. Captured native graphs use the same admission limits. Do not test resource exhaustion by compiling exponential native graphs.

Run tools/qualify_blender_imported_materials.py: independently check packed-texture colours, colliding multi-import material names, derived DAG slots/face indices/data ownership, coforged readbacks/publication metadata, unlit source shader classes, anisotropy/absorption source fidelity and explicitly adopted original-source removal/reuse. Preserve unchanged-save and restored positives; unsupported source classes must refuse.

Run tools/qualify_blender_material_selections.py: require literal white/black selection-mask pixels and refreshed-hash PUBLIC plus direct-native refusals for authored, captured and ObjectInfo-derived meshes; unqueried native selections and unchanged/restored saves must remain valid. Explicitly adopted edited original bytes must form a NEW verified output and survive precursor removal/reuse, never select a submitted-state migration reader.

Run the surface qualifier family: independently check Fresnel/coat reflection, Snell solid/thin transmission in Cycles and EEVEE, Lambert/TBN including mirrored stored UV and object/world encoding, literal packed channels/alpha, displacement silhouette, built-in OSL Smart interpolation, connected linked-product variants, coforged UV/hidden shader-state refusal and restored lifecycle controls. Keep all original failed oracle/harness epochs. No general image-equivalence or whole-application inference follows.

Qualify saved time/camera markers/gravity, Curve/Font render-only inputs, Workbench object shadows, current source-bound driver refusal, and explicit point-selection conservatism with original/save/coforged/restored controls. Fixed5.2.3 API inventory and native WIRE/BOUNDS controls distinguish actual renderer inputs from presentation; this does not close broader driver or material families.

Run the public A/B/C render-bundle qualifier and lifecycle: require literal field300, oblique optical-axis depth/world normals, Material/World AOVs and disjoint lightgroups, exact Cryptomatte bits/membership, captured per-part masks and source-retired verified reuse.
Run the public Freestyle raster and lifecycle qualifiers with refreshed complete native witnesses and actual saved edits.

Run tools/qualify_blender_caches.py across all three admitted modes; require fresh all-frame geometry, before-open disk payload refusals, source-retired workflow reuse and actual active-bake cancellation/deadline recovery.
